designBrief: Original flat cartoon vocabulary picture; thick rounded saturated-purple outlines (#7537df, 10-unit exterior strokes); bright orange, pink, purple, and yellow fills; transparent 256 by 256 canvas; centered subject with generous margins; no text, object faces, gradients, shadows, textures, or external resources.
historicMedia: Earlier raster illustrations and their image-provenance.json records are retained; these SVGs are newly authored illustrations, not vectorizations of those images.
